title: Content review
summary: Reviews a chapter, article, script, post or outline against its brief, quoting evidence for every judgment, checking facts and AI-writing tells, and returning a clear pass/fail with must-fix notes.
changes: Borrowed from haowjy story-review (resources/editorial-review.md, developmental-edit.md, line-edit.md, copyedit.md): the editorial memo shape (overall diagnosis, priority order, major notes, recurring line patterns, surface patterns, revision order), the big-before-small edit-level order, the structural-action vocabulary (cut, move, expand, combine, split, reframe, seed earlier, delay payoff), and the protect-the-voice / query-before-overriding / name-patterns-not-instances discipline, paraphrased and generalized from fiction to any written or spoken piece.
